first.description: Whether the current Page is the first one.

last.description: Whether the current Page is the last one.

number.description: The number of the current Page. Is always non-negative.

numberOfElements.description: The number of elements currently on this Page.

empty.description: Whether the current Page is empty.

offset.description: The offset to be taken according to the underlying page and page size.

paged.description: True if this response is paginated.

unpaged.description: True if this response is not paginated.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

empty.description: True if the request had no sort parameters defined.

unsorted.description: True if this response is not sorted.

sorted.description: True if this response is sorted.

name.description: Application name. For applications created in Assess or Protect, the agent assigns the name.

displayName.description: Name that appears in Contrast when displaying this application. Overrides the name field if present.

path.description: The root path this application is hosted on in the web server. This is discovered by the Assess or Protect agent.

importance.description: Level of importance of this application in the organization. Applications with a higher level of importance are more scrutinized for security issues.

tags.description: Application tags. Tags are labels that can be assigned to applications to help organize applications and improve search functionality. These can be configured in the agent's configuration file or via the Contrast web interface.

metadata.description: Metadata assigned to this application. This is a set of key-value pairs that are defined either in the agent's configuration file or in the Contrast web interface. Metadata fields are predefined at the Organization level and strongly typed.

firstSeenTime.description: The first time this application was observed by an agent, or the time this application was manually created (if not created by an agent).

lastSeenTime.description: The most recent time an Assess or Protect agent observed activity for this application or it was scanned by SCA.

V4Application.description: Represents a single executable component that can be instrumented or otherwise assessed for security vulnerabilities.
